purpose: Remi.dc.html is the app shell and single source of truth for the prototype. It holds all domain data in component state: projects, routines, task completion, BAU completion, fund-run progress, notes, activity feed and UI state. It persists that data to localStorage 'remi.v1'. Its buildModel() computes every derived value: business-day calendar, per-day capacity loads, project status and forecast deltas, the move verdict, attention list, check-in prompt, routine occurrences and a previewShift helper. It passes one `model` object (data, derived values and action callbacks) to every screen. It also renders the chrome: an 88px left rail, a 72px header with date, countdown, verdict, search and 'Tell Remi', eight stacked screens that cross-fade, the check-in drawer (CheckIn component) and the ⌘K command palette with quick-add scope parsing.
layout:
OUTER VIEWPORT: div position:fixed; inset:0; overflow:hidden; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 6%, var(--paper)). This is the letterbox colour around the scaled stage.

STAGE (data-screen-label="Remi app"): position:absolute; left:{st.x}px; top:{st.y}px; width:{st.w}px; height:{st.h}px; transform:scale({st.s}); transform-origin:0 0; background:var(--paper); display:grid; grid-template-columns: 88px minmax(0,1fr); overflow:hidden.
- Frame sizing from prop `frame`: '1920 × 1080' gives W,H = 1920,1080; '2560 × 1440' gives 2560,1440; 'Fit window' gives W,H = window.innerWidth/innerHeight at scale 1.
- For fixed frames, scale = min(vw/W, vh/H). It scales up as well as down. The stage is centred: x = round((vw − W·s)/2), y = round((vh − H·s)/2). Everything inside is laid out at the design pixel size and then scaled.
- At 1920×1080 the rail is 88px, content 1832px wide, header 72px, main area 1008px tall. At 2560×1440 content is 2472px wide and main is 1368px tall; the layout is the same, only wider.

LEFT RAIL (<nav>): flex column; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:22px 0 20px; border-right:1px solid var(--hairline).
1. Home/wordmark button: flex column, centred, gap 6px, width 72px, padding 8px 0 10px, margin-bottom 18px, border 0, radius var(--radius-m) 6px, transparent background, colour var(--ink); hover background color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 5%, transparent); transition background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out). Contents: 'Remi' in var(--font-display), 22px, line-height 1, letter-spacing −0.01em. Below it a row (gap 2px; 10px; weight 500; ink-muted) with the Material Symbol 'chevron_left' at 13px and the text 'Home'. title="Back to home".
2. Seven nav buttons from SCREENS: each 72×62px; flex column centred; gap 6px; border 1px solid {bd}; background {bg}; colour {fg}; radius 6px; padding 0; transition background/color/border-color var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out). Icon: Material Symbols Outlined 22px, line-height 1, font-variation-settings 'FILL' 0, 'wght' 300, 'opsz' 24. Label: 11px, weight 500, letter-spacing 0.01em. Active: bg var(--paper-raised), border var(--hairline), fg var(--ink). Inactive: transparent, transparent, var(--ink-muted). 'Projects' is also active when screen === 'workspace'. title = label.
3. flex:1 spacer.
4. Palette button: 72×52px; flex column centred; gap 4px; 1px transparent border; transparent background; colour ink-muted; radius 6px. 'search' icon at 20px, wght 300. '⌘K' in var(--font-numeric) 11px. title="Search or add (⌘K)".

RIGHT COLUMN: display:grid; grid-template-rows: 72px minmax(0,1fr); min-width:0; min-height:0.

HEADER (72px): flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; padding:0 48px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline). Left to right:
(a) Date group (flex, baseline, gap 10px): 'Mon 5 Oct' at 17px/600, letter-spacing −0.005em (HARD-CODED); '·' in var(--ink-faint); 'BD3' in font-numeric 13px/500, ink-muted (HARD-CODED).
(b) Vertical divider 1×22px, var(--hairline).
(c) Countdown button (border 0, transparent, padding 0, baseline, gap 8px): '61' at 17px/600 (HARD-CODED) and 'business days to Fixed Income' at 15px ink-muted. Click goes to the 'transition' screen.
(d) Verdict (flex, centred, gap 8px, 13px, ink-muted): a 6×6px circle filled with verdict.dot, then verdict.word.
(e) flex:1 spacer.
(f) Search button: height 36px; padding 0 10px 0 12px; min-width 260px; border 1px hairline; radius 6px; background paper-raised; colour ink-muted; 14px; gap 10px. Contains the 'search' icon (18px, wght 300), the text 'Jump to or add' (flex:1, left-aligned) and a '⌘K' chip (font-numeric 11px; padding 2px 6px; 1px hairline border; radius var(--radius-s) 3px).
(g) Primary 'Tell Remi' button: height 36px; padding 0 16px 0 12px; border 0; radius 6px; background var(--ink); colour var(--paper); 14px/600; gap 8px. Hover background color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 86%, var(--paper)); active transform scale(0.98). Icon 'edit_note' at 18px, wght 400.

MAIN (<main>): position:relative; min-height:0; min-width:0. Contains 8 <section>s, all absolutely stacked with inset:0 and all mounted at all times. Only opacity, visibility and transition change. Sections and their overflow: Today (overflow:auto), Notes (overflow:hidden; the dc-import itself is position:absolute; inset:0), Timeline (overflow:hidden), Calendar (auto), Projects (auto), Project workspace (auto), Routines (auto), Transition (auto). Each section passes model={model} to its child.

CHECK-IN DRAWER LAYER: absolute; inset 0 (covers the rail too); z-index 20; pointer-events auto when open, none when closed.
- Scrim: absolute; inset 0; background color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 18%, transparent); opacity 0 or 1; click closes the drawer.
- Panel (data-screen-label="Check-in drawer"): absolute; top 0; right 0; bottom 0; width 1160px; max-width calc(100% − 160px); background paper; border-left 1px hairline; box-shadow −24px 0 48px −32px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 30%, transparent). transform translateX(0) when open, translateX(104%) when closed.
- Hosts <CheckIn> at absolute inset 0 with props: model, open, pid, session, prefill, on-close=closeDrawer, on-save=saveCheckIn.

COMMAND PALETTE LAYER: absolute; inset 0; z-index 30 (above the drawer); pointer-events auto or none.
- Scrim: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 10%, transparent); click closes.
- Panel: absolute; left 50%; top 132px; width 680px; margin-left −340px; background paper-raised; 1px hairline border; radius 6px; box-shadow 0 24px 48px −28px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 35%, transparent); overflow hidden.
- Input row: height 60px; padding 0 18px; gap 12px; border-bottom hairline. 'search' icon 20px, ink-muted, wght 300. <input> is flex:1, borderless, no outline, transparent, 17px, ink. An 'esc' chip follows (font-numeric 11px, ink-muted, padding 2px 6px, hairline border, radius 3px).
- Results: padding 6px 8px 10px; max-height 460px; overflow auto.
  - Group label: padding 12px 12px 6px; 11px/600; letter-spacing 0.08em; uppercase; ink-muted.
  - Item button: width 100%; flex; centred; gap 12px; padding 0 12px; height 40px; border 0; radius 3px; background {it.bg}; text-align left; transition background var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out). Contents: a 7×7px dot in {it.dot}; the label (flex:1, 14px, ink); the hint (font-numeric 12px, ink-muted).
  - Empty state: padding 28px 12px; 14px; ink-muted.

components.name: Frame/Stage scaler
components.description: The fixed 1920×1080 or 2560×1440 design canvas is scaled with CSS transform to fit the window and centred, with letterbox colour color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 6%, var(--paper)). 'Fit window' uses the real viewport size at scale 1. In production, drop the scaler and build the layout responsively. Both reference sizes should look like this layout: 88px rail, 72px header, fluid main area.

components.name: Left rail
components.description: 88px column. From the top: Remi wordmark / Home button (serif 22px 'Remi' over '‹ Home' at 10px), 7 nav buttons (72×62px, 22px Material Symbol at wght 300, 11px/500 label) in order Today [icon today], Notes [notes], Timeline [view_timeline], Calendar [calendar_month], Projects [stacks], Routines [repeat], Transition [arrow_forward]. Then a flexible spacer and a ⌘K search button at the bottom (72×52px). Active style is paper-raised background, hairline border and ink text. Inactive is transparent with ink-muted text. Colour changes take 140ms ease-out.

components.name: Header bar
components.description: 72px bar with 48px side padding and 28px gaps. Holds the today date and BD number (hard-coded 'Mon 5 Oct · BD3'), a 1×22px divider, the countdown button ('61 business days to Fixed Income', hard-coded, goes to Transition), the verdict (6px dot plus word), a spacer, the 'Jump to or add ⌘K' search trigger (min 260px wide, 36px tall) and the primary 'Tell Remi' button (ink background, paper text, edit_note icon).
states: verdict: Move on track / Move on track, narrowly (dot var(--ink))
Off track for the move (dot var(--overload))

components.name: Screen stack
components.description: Eight child screens are always mounted in absolutely stacked sections: Today, Notes, Timeline, Calendar, Projects, Workspace, Routines, Transition. The active screen has opacity 1 and visibility visible. The others have opacity 0 and visibility hidden. See the motion section for the cross-fade. Because nothing unmounts, each screen keeps its local state and scroll position when you switch away. Notes and Timeline sections are overflow:hidden (they scroll internally). The rest are overflow:auto.
states: instant (no transition, used during view transition)

components.name: Check-in drawer
components.description: Right-hand sheet 1160px wide (max calc(100% − 160px)) over an ink 18% scrim. It slides in from translateX(104%). It hosts the CheckIn component, which gets `session` (incremented on each open to reset its internal state), `pid` (focus project or null), `prefill` ({scopeH} from the palette quick-add, or {text} from Notes) and `open`. Clicking the scrim or pressing Escape closes it (Escape only when the palette is closed). The panel's opacity also toggles 0/1.

components.name: Command palette
components.description: 680px wide panel, centred, 132px from the top of the stage, over an ink 10% scrim. It has a 60px input row and grouped results (max 16 items, max-height 460px, scrolls). Groups: Quick add, Jump to, Projects, Tell Remi, Create. The selected row background is color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 6%, var(--paper-raised)). Hovering a row selects it. Each row shows a coloured 7px dot, a label and a monospace hint.

dataConsumed: PROPS (data-props metadata): frame: enum ['1920 × 1080','2560 × 1440','Fit window'], default '1920 × 1080', section 'Viewport'. motion: enum ['Full','Reduced'], default 'Full', section 'Motion'. accents: colour pair string[], default ['#526e2a','#47619c'], options [['#526e2a','#47619c'],['#00737e','#5e5a9a'],['#1f744f','#32669a'],['#884b75','#007187']], section 'Brand stand-ins'. serif: boolean, default true, section 'Brand stand-ins'.

CONSTANTS: DAY=86400000. dn(iso) = round(Date.UTC(y,m-1,d)/DAY), a UTC epoch day number. isoOf(n) = ISO string of day n. TODAY=dn('2026-10-05') (=20731, a Monday). MOVE=dn('2027-01-04'). DEC_RUN=dn('2026-12-03') (Thu, December BD3, the last returns run the successor can shadow). CAL0=dn('2026-08-31'), CAL1=dn('2027-04-30'). CAPACITY=8 hours per business day.
WDS ['Sun'..'Sat'], WDL full weekday names, MOS ['Jan'..'Dec'], MOL full month names.
HOL (holiday map ISO→name): '2026-12-25' Christmas Day, '2026-12-28' Boxing Day (substitute), '2027-01-01' New Year's Day, '2027-03-26' Good Friday, '2027-03-29' Easter Monday.

CAL object: days[n] = {n, iso, w (0=Sun), m (0-based month), d (day of month), y, bd (true if Mon–Fri and not a holiday), bdm (business-day-of-month counter, 1-based, reset each calendar month; null if not a BD), hol (name or null)} for every day CAL0..CAL1. bds = ordered array of BD day numbers (170 in the range; first Mon 31 Aug 2026, last Fri 30 Apr 2027). idx[n] = position of BD n in bds. nextBD(n) = the first day ≥ n that is a BD (stops if n leaves the range). addBD(n,k) = bds[clamp(idx[nextBD(n)] + k, 0, bds.length−1)]. bdDiff(a,b) = idx[nextBD(b)] − idx[nextBD(a)].
F formatters: s(n) → 'Mon 5 Oct'. dm(n) → '5 Oct'. l(n) → 'Monday 5 October'. wd(n) → 'Mon'. mon(n) → 'Oct'. monL(n) → 'October'. d(n) → day of month. iso = isoOf. dn = dn.

FUNDS (12 strings): 'Senior Direct Lending I', 'Senior Direct Lending II', 'Unitranche Partners', 'Mezzanine Opportunities', 'Asset-Backed Finance', 'Infrastructure Debt', 'Real Estate Debt', 'Trade Finance', 'Special Situations', 'Opportunistic Credit', 'Credit Co-invest', 'Evergreen Income'.

ROUTINE shape: {id, domain 'pc'|'fi', name, short, detail, rule (seed string, overwritten in the derived model), kind 'monthly'|'weekly'|'daily', bd (business day of month, for monthly), wd (weekday 0–6, for weekly), h (hours per occurrence), pid (linked project id or null), status, statusNote, readiness (0–1), stage (0 Manual, 1 Automating, 2 Shadowed, 3 Handed over)}. normR defaults: domain 'pc', kind 'monthly', bd 5, wd 2, h 1, stage 0, statusNote '', detail '', pid null; short falls back to name. Seeds are forced to kind='monthly', stage=1.

ROT_DEF (FI country rotation, as [country, code, lengthBD, pass]): Germany DE 6 Build; France FR 5 Build; Italy IT 6 Build; Spain ES 5 Build; Netherlands NL 4 Build; Belgium BE 4 Build; Austria AT 4 Build; Portugal PT 4 Build; Ireland IE 4 Build; Finland FI 4 Build; Germany DE 3 Refresh. ROT segments = {i, country, code, len, pass, s (start n), e (end n), sS, eS}, laid end to end from MOVE. Computed: DE Mon 4 Jan–Mon 11 Jan | FR Tue 12 Jan–Mon 18 Jan | IT Tue 19 Jan–Tue 26 Jan | ES Wed 27 Jan–Tue 2 Feb | NL Wed 3 Feb–Mon 8 Feb | BE Tue 9 Feb–Fri 12 Feb | AT Mon 15 Feb–Thu 18 Feb | PT Fri 19 Feb–Wed 24 Feb | IE Thu 25 Feb–Tue 2 Mar | FI Wed 3 Mar–Mon 8 Mar | DE Refresh Tue 9 Mar–Thu 11 Mar.
PHASES = ['Define','Plan','Run','Close'] (project.phase index). STAGES = ['Manual','Automating','Shadowed','Handed over'] (routine.stage index).

PROJECT stored shape (normalize() defaults in brackets): {id, domain 'pc'|'fi', name, short, goal, start ISO, target ISO, targetLabel? (display override, e.g. 'Late Mar 2027'), forecast ISO|null, prev ISO|null (forecast before the last slip), exit string[]|null (exit routes, e.g. ['Automate','Hand over']; [] for new PC, null for FI), confidence 1–5|null, checkin ISO|null (last check-in), phase 0–3, rate (planned hours per normal BD), bd3 (hours on BD3), bd8 (hours on BD8), rateAfter (hours per BD after MOVE), ov {ISO: hours} per-day overrides [{}], baseline (baseline hours), readiness 0–1 (PC), readinessList? [{t, done?, due?}] (FI onboarding), milestones [{name,date}] (legacy/explicit) [[]], endName (label for the end marker), charter {why, success[], inScope[], outScope[], constraints[]} [all empty], now [{m (milestone name), due ISO, tasks [{id, t, h, due?}]}] [[]], next [{m, due}] [[]], later string [''], scope [{date, what, h, bd (BD slip), from 'D Mon', to 'D Mon'}] [[]], checkins [{date, note, forecast ISO|null, conf, ms? [{name,date}]}] [[]], risks [{r (pre-mortem failure), m (mitigation)}] [[]], checklists [{id, title, items [{id, t, done}]}] [[]], blocker? string|null (set by check-in)}.

DERIVED project P[i] = the stored project plus: milestones (derivedMs), startN, targetN, forecastN (null if no forecast), prevN; delta = bdDiff(targetN, forecastN) or null; status = forecastN==null ? 'define' : delta>0 ? 'risk' : 'on'; since = TODAY − dn(checkin) in CALENDAR days, or null; stale = since≥7; added = Σ scope.h; growth = baseline ? round(added/baseline*100) : 0; accent = 'var(--pc-accent)' or 'var(--fi-accent)'; soft = 'var(--pc-accent-soft)' or 'var(--fi-accent-soft)'; domainName 'Private Credit' or 'Fixed Income'; forecastS (F.s, or 'Not yet'); forecastDM (F.dm, or '—'); targetS/targetDM (targetLabel if set, else F.s/F.dm); prevS/prevDM (or null); deltaLabel = 'No forecast' | '+N BD' | '−N BD' (U+2212) | 'On target'; sinceLabel = 'Not yet' | 'Today' | 'Yesterday' | 'N days ago'; phaseName; flash (bool); moved ({delta,label,at} or null); statusColor = risk→'var(--risk)', define→'var(--ink-faint)', else the accent.
pmap: id → derived project.
loads: {n → dayLoad(n,P,routines)} for every BD in CAL. Shape: {n, items [{id, pid, kind 'bau'|'proj', domain, h, name}], bau, proj, total, free, over}.
verdict {word, short, dot, tone, sentence, buffer, toRun}.
upcoming [{n, s, bdm, total}] (overloaded days from TODAY to addBD(MOVE,10)).
attention [{id, pid, day?, kind 'At risk'|'Overload'|'Stale', title, body, chip, tone 'risk'|'overload'|'quiet'}].
prompt: the project with the oldest check-in if it is stale, else null. nextDue: the project with the oldest check-in (or null).
routines (derived): routine + {rule: ruleText, ruleShort, stageName, status: STAGES[stage], next: first 3 occurrences on or after TODAY → [{n, s, after (n≥MOVE), today}]}.

STATE (persisted): projects (stored shape above), routines, tasks {taskId: boolean} (task completion lives outside projects), doneOn {taskId: ISO completion date}, bauDone {'<routineId>:<occurrence ISO>': ISO done date}, funds boolean[12] (progress of today's returns run, one per fund), notes {ISO day: [{id, t 'HH:MM', text}]}, feed [{id, pid|null, kind 'scope'|'stale'|'overload'|'checkin'|'edit', title, body, delta (chip text), tone 'risk'|'quiet'|'overload', when (display string), day? ISO}].

STATE (not persisted): screen ('today'|'notes'|'timeline'|'calendar'|'projects'|'workspace'|'routines'|'transition'); ws (workspace project id, default 'ret'); hover (shared cross-screen hover id: project id, routine id or 'rot'); drawer {open, pid, session, prefill}; pal {open, q, i}; flash {pid: bool}; moved {pid: {delta, label, at}|null}; vtPhase ('from'|'to'|null); vtId; instant (bool); vw, vh; focusGoal; focusRoutine; routineReq {id, t}; dayReq {n, t}.

MODEL object passed to every screen: TODAY, MOVE, DEC_RUN, CAPACITY, F, CAL, ROT, PHASES, HOL, FUNDS, P, pmap, loads, routines, verdict, attention, prompt, nextDue, feed, upcoming, hover, setHover, go, openProject, openCheckIn, funds, toggleFund, tasks, toggleTask, doneOn, bauDone, toggleBau, setAllFunds, ws, screen, vtPhase, vtId, previewShift, reduced (props.motion==='Reduced' only), STAGES, occursOn(r,n), updateRoutine, addRoutine, removeRoutine, focusRoutine, clearFocusRoutine, routineReq, openRoutine, notes, addNote, updateNote, removeNote, dayReq, previewDay, updateProject, logChange, createProject, removeProject, focusGoal, clearFocusGoal.

CheckIn → onSave payload: currently always {changes: Change[]}. Change is one of: {type:'task_done',project_id,task_id} | {type:'task_add',project_id,text,hours} | {type:'scope_add',project_id,text,hours} | {type:'blocker',project_id,text} | {type:'confidence',project_id,value 1–5} | {type:'target_move',project_id,date ISO (snapped to next BD by CheckIn)} | {type:'hours_per_day',project_id,value 0<v≤8} | {type:'note',project_id,text} | {type:'bau_done',routine_id}. A legacy payload is also handled: {pid, done: taskId[], changed, scopeWhat, scopeH, blockers, confidence}.
interactions: ⌘K / Ctrl+K anywhere (global window keydown, preventDefault, fires even while typing in inputs) toggles the command palette.
Escape (global): if the palette is open, close it; otherwise if the drawer is open, close it.

Rail Home/wordmark button (goHome): unless motion is reduced, fades the stage opacity to 0 over 180ms var(--ease-out), then after 180ms navigates to 'Remi Home.dc.html'. With reduced motion it navigates immediately.
Rail nav button → go(id): sets screen, instant=false, closes the palette. Does not close the drawer.
Rail ⌘K button and header 'Jump to or add' button → openPalette(): pal={open:true, q:'', i:0}, then focuses the input 30ms later.
Header countdown '61 business days to Fixed Income' → go('transition').
Header 'Tell Remi' → openCheckIn(screen==='workspace' ? ws : null).

openCheckIn(pid, prefill): drawer={open:true, pid: pid||null, session: session+1, prefill: prefill||null}; closes the palette. A new session tells CheckIn to reset its composer (prefill.scopeH becomes the text 'New scope on <short>, about Nh: '; prefill.text is used verbatim).
Drawer scrim click, CheckIn onClose, or Escape → closeDrawer (open=false; pid, session and prefill are kept).
CheckIn onSave → saveCheckIn(d): close the drawer immediately, then after 220ms run applyUpdate(d.changes) if d.changes exists, else applyCheckIn(d).
Palette input onChange → pal.q = value, pal.i = 0 (selection resets on every keystroke).
Palette input keydown: ArrowDown (preventDefault) → i = min(n−1, sel+1). ArrowUp (preventDefault) → i = max(0, sel−1). Enter → run the selected item. There is no wrap-around.
Palette row mouseenter → select that row (setState only if it changed). Row click → run item.
Palette palette scrim click → closePalette (only open=false; q is kept but reset on the next open).

Palette actions: Quick add → openCheckIn(pid, {scopeH:h}). Jump to → go(screen). Projects → openProject(id) (no view transition, since viaCard is not set). Tell Remi → openCheckIn(id). Create → createProject('pc'|'fi'). Reset → resetData().

openProject(id, viaCard) (called from child screens): closes the palette. If viaCard is falsy, or document.startViewTransition is unsupported, or motion is reduced, or the current screen is already 'workspace', it just sets screen='workspace', ws=id. Otherwise it runs the shared-element view transition (see motion).
openRoutine(id) (from children): routineReq={id, t:Date.now()}, screen='routines'. Routines watches for a new t and scrolls to/opens that routine.
previewDay(n) (from Calendar): dayReq={n, t:Date.now()}, screen='today'. Today calls pick(n) when it sees a new t.
setHover(id) (from children): shared hover id for cross-highlighting (projects, routines, 'rot'). setState only fires if the value changed.

Child actions that change data: toggleTask, toggleBau, toggleFund, setAllFunds, addNote, updateNote, removeNote, updateProject, logChange, createProject, removeProject, updateRoutine, addRoutine, removeRoutine (see actionsInvoked).
Window resize → updates vw and vh (re-scales the stage).
motion: TOKENS: --dur-fast 140ms; --dur-base 240ms; --dur-slow 440ms; --ease-out cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1). --spring-soft is linear(0, 0.049 5%, 0.156 10%, 0.283 15%, 0.408 20%, 0.522 25%, 0.62 30%, 0.702 35%, 0.769 40%, 0.864 50%, 0.922 60%, 0.956 70%, 0.976 80%, 0.987 90%, 1). With reduced motion (:root[data-motion="reduced"] or @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)), --spring-soft becomes steps(1, jump-start) and spring motions jump instantly. The duration tokens are unchanged in reduced mode, so opacity fades that use --ease-out still run.

SCREEN CROSS-FADE: the incoming screen gets 'opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out) 60ms, visibility 0s linear 0s' (fades in over 240ms after a 60ms delay; visible immediately). The outgoing screen gets 'opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out), visibility 0s linear var(--dur-fast)' (fades out over 140ms, then becomes hidden at 140ms). When state.instant is true, transition is 'none' on every section.

SHARED-ELEMENT VIEW TRANSITION (Projects card goal → Workspace goal): (1) setState vtPhase='from', vtId=id. Projects puts view-transition-name:'remi-goal' on that card's goal text. (2) document.startViewTransition(() => new Promise(res => setState({screen:'workspace', ws:id, vtPhase:'to', instant:true}, res))). Workspace puts view-transition-name:'remi-goal' on its goal textarea, and instant:true removes the CSS cross-fade so the new snapshot is final. (3) transition.finished.finally → vtPhase=null, vtId=null, instant=false. CSS: ::view-transition-group(remi-goal){animation-duration:420ms; animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)}. ::view-transition-old(remi-goal), ::view-transition-new(remi-goal){height:100%; width:auto; object-fit:none; object-position:left top} (text moves without stretching). ::view-transition-old(root), ::view-transition-new(root){animation-duration:220ms} (root cross-fade). :root[data-motion="reduced"]::view-transition-group(*){animation-duration:0s}. The transition is skipped entirely when reduced() is true (props.motion==='Reduced' OR the prefers-reduced-motion media query).

DRAWER: scrim opacity 0↔1 with 'opacity var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out)' (240ms). Panel transform translateX(104%) ↔ translateX(0) with 'transform var(--dur-slow) var(--spring-soft)' (440ms spring), plus opacity 0↔1 over 240ms ease-out. It uses the same transition in both directions.

PALETTE: scrim opacity with 'opacity var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out)' (140ms). Panel opacity 0↔1 over 140ms ease-out and transform translateY(-8px) ↔ translateY(0) with 'transform var(--dur-base) var(--spring-soft)' (240ms spring). Items change background over 140ms ease-out.

Nav buttons: background, color and border-color change over 140ms ease-out. Home button background changes over 140ms ease-out on hover. The Tell Remi hover background and active scale(0.98) have no transition declared, so they are instant.
GO HOME: inline style on the stage, opacity → 0 with 'opacity 180ms var(--ease-out)', then navigation at 180ms. Skipped when motion is reduced.

CHECK-IN APPLY CHOREOGRAPHY: the drawer closes first; changes apply 220ms later, so the forecast move is visible on screen. After a forecast slip: flash[pid]=true for 1100ms (Timeline consumes it). moved[pid]={delta, label:'+N BD', at} for 5200ms (Timeline and Workspace consume it). A forecast change from hours_per_day sets flash for 1100ms. A new check-in on the same project clears and restarts the timers.

GLOBAL KEYFRAMES defined here, used by children: @keyframes remi-pulse {0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--overload) 50%, transparent)} 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px color-mix(in oklch, var(--overload) 0%, transparent)}} (overload ring, used by Today, Timeline and Calendar). @keyframes remi-settle {from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}} (not referenced by any screen file). @keyframes remi-tick {0%{transform:scale(0.6)} 60%{transform:scale(1.08)} 100%{transform:scale(1)}} (not referenced by any screen file).
Palette focus: the input is focused 30ms after opening, so it happens after the panel becomes interactive.
algorithms: BUSINESS-DAY CALENDAR: iterate UTC days CAL0 (2026-08-31) to CAL1 (2027-04-30). bd = weekday Mon–Fri AND not in HOL. bdm = running count of BDs within the calendar month (1-based, reset when the UTC month changes); null on non-BDs. bds = list of BDs; idx = reverse index. nextBD(n): advance n while days[n] exists and is not a BD. addBD(n,k) = bds[clamp(idx[nextBD(n)]+k, 0, len−1)] (silently clamps at the ends of the range; k can be negative). bdDiff(a,b) = idx[nextBD(b)] − idx[nextBD(a)] (non-BD inputs snap forward; result is NaN if outside the range). Example: bdDiff(TODAY, MOVE) = 62 (BDs from Mon 5 Oct inclusive up to Mon 4 Jan exclusive).

ROTATION LAYOUT: s = MOVE. For each ROT_DEF [country, code, len, pass]: e = addBD(s, len−1); segment {s, e}; s = addBD(e, 1). Segments are back to back in business days (49 BD in total, ending Thu 11 Mar 2027).

ROUTINE OCCURRENCE occurs(r, d): false if d is missing or not a BD. kind 'daily' → true. kind 'weekly' → d.w === r.wd. kind 'monthly' (the default when kind is missing) → d.bdm === r.bd. A monthly routine with bd greater than the month's BD count never fires; there is no clamp to the last BD.

ruleText(r): daily → 'Every business day'; weekly → 'Every ' + WDL[wd]; monthly → ORD(bd) + ' business day, monthly'. ORD adds st/nd/rd/th, with 11/12/13 → th. ruleShort(r): 'Daily' | 'Weekly · ' + WDS[wd] | 'BD' + bd.

DAY LOAD dayLoad(n, projects, routines): return null if n is not a BD. BAU: if n < MOVE, then for every routine with stage < 3 (not handed over) that occurs(r, day), push {id:r.id, pid:r.pid, kind:'bau', domain:'pc' (hard-coded, whatever r.domain is), h:+r.h||0, name: r.short||r.name||'Untitled routine'}. If n ≥ MOVE, routines are ignored; if n falls inside a ROT segment, push {id:'rot', pid:'rot', kind:'bau', domain:'fi', h:4 (hard-coded), name: country + ' · ' + pass}. PROJECTS: for each p, end = forecastN ?? targetN; skip if n < startN or n > end. Hours, first match wins: p.ov[iso] (explicit per-day override, even 0) → (n ≥ MOVE) rateAfter||0 → (bdm===3) bd3 → (bdm===8) bd8 → rate. Push {id, pid, kind:'proj', domain, h, name: p.short} only if h > 0. bau = Σ BAU h; proj = Σ project h; total = bau + proj; free = max(0, 8 − total); over = total > 8 (strictly greater). BD3 and BD8 are fixed numbers in this rule, not read from the routines' bd values.

PROJECT STATUS: delta = bdDiff(targetN, forecastN) (business days late, positive = late). status = no forecast ? 'define' : delta > 0 ? 'risk' : 'on' (being early counts as 'on'). stale = days since the last check-in (calendar days) ≥ 7. growth% = round(Σscope.h / baseline × 100).

DERIVED MILESTONES derivedMs(p): Map keyed by name. First, every entry in now[] and next[] that has both m and due becomes {name:m, date:due} (a later duplicate name overwrites an earlier one). Then legacy p.milestones entries are added only if their name is not already present AND their date is not already used by a derived one. Sort by ISO date ascending. Result: the plan's now/next items are the milestones; explicit milestones only fill gaps.

MOVE VERDICT: pcP = PC-domain projects. lastPC = max(forecastN of pcP); null forecasts coerce to 0 inside Math.max. buffer = bdDiff(lastPC, MOVE). ret = pmap['ret'] (hard-coded). toRun = bdDiff(ret.forecastN, DEC_RUN). Rules in order: (1) any PC forecastN ≥ MOVE → {word:'Off track for the move', short:'Not yet', dot/tone:'var(--overload)', sentence:'A Private Credit exit now lands on or after 4 Jan. Something has to be cut, automated later, or handed over as it stands.'}. (2) else if ret.forecastN ≥ DEC_RUN → {word:'Move at risk', short:'At risk', dot/tone:'var(--risk)', sentence:'Every Private Credit exit still lands before 4 Jan, but the returns pipeline now misses the December run on Thu 3 Dec, the last one your successor can shadow with you there.'}. (3) else → word 'Move on track, narrowly' (short 'Yes, narrowly') if ANY project (any domain) has status 'risk', otherwise 'Move on track' (short 'Yes'); dot/tone 'var(--ink)'; sentence 'Every Private Credit exit lands before 4 Jan, with {buffer} business days to spare. The one to watch is the returns pipeline: forecast {ret.forecastS}, {toRun} business day(s) before the December run your successor needs to shadow.' buffer and toRun are attached to the verdict. Seed result: 'Move on track, narrowly', buffer 8, toRun 1.
UPCOMING OVERLOADS: BDs n with TODAY ≤ n ≤ addBD(MOVE,10) (Mon 18 Jan) and loads[n].over → {n, s, bdm, total}. Seed: only Wed 4 Nov (BD3), 9.5h (Returns BAU 6h + returns pipeline override 3.5h).

ATTENTION LIST (in this order): (a) each risk project → {id:'a-'+id, pid, kind:'At risk', title:name, body:'Forecast '+forecastS+', target '+targetS, chip:deltaLabel, tone:'risk'}; (b) each upcoming overload → {id:'o-'+n, pid:null, day:n, kind:'Overload', title: s+' (BD'+bdm+')', body: total+'h of an 8h day', chip:'+'+(total−8)+'h', tone:'overload'}; (c) each stale project → {id:'s-'+id, pid, kind:'Stale', title:name, body:'No check-in for '+since+' days', chip: since+'d', tone:'quiet'}. Seed: [At risk Returns pipeline +3 BD, Overload Wed 4 Nov (BD3) +1.5h, Stale ManCo 9d].
CHECK-IN PROMPT: candidates = projects with since ≠ null, sorted by since descending. prompt = candidates[0] if it is stale, else null. nextDue = candidates[0] or null. Seed: prompt = manco (9 days).

ROUTINE NEXT OCCURRENCES: the first 3 BDs ≥ TODAY where occurs(r). These can fall after MOVE (after:true), even though BAU stops at the move. Seed r-ret: Mon 5 Oct, Wed 4 Nov, Thu 3 Dec. r-man: Mon 12 Oct, Wed 11 Nov, Thu 10 Dec.

CHECK-IN APPLY applyCheckIn(d) where d = {pid, done[], changed, scopeWhat, scopeH, blockers, confidence}: hasF = project has a forecast. slipBD = hasF && scopeH>0 ? ceil(scopeH / (rate || 1)) : 0 (uses the flat rate only; ignores bd3/bd8/ov/rateAfter). newF = slipBD ? addBD(fN, slipBD) : fN. what = trimmed scopeWhat, or 'New scope'. note = [changed, scopeH>0 ? what+' added, +'+scopeH+'h' : '', blockers ? 'Blocked: '+blockers : ''].filter(Boolean).join('. '), or 'Plan confirmed.' if that is empty. Project updates: forecast=iso(newF) (or null); prev = slipBD ? old forecast : old prev; confidence = d.confidence ?? old; checkin = TODAY; blocker = d.blockers || null (every check-in overwrites or clears it); if scopeH>0, append scope {date:TODAY, what, h:scopeH, bd:slipBD, from: F.dm(fN) or '—', to: F.dm(newF) or '—'}; always append checkin {date:TODAY, note, forecast, conf}. tasks[id]=true for each id in d.done (doneOn is NOT set). Feed item: if slipBD → {kind:'scope', title:short, body:'Scope added ('+what.toLowerCase()+', +'+h+'h). Forecast moved '+dm(fN)+' → '+dm(newF)+'.', delta:'+N BD', tone:'risk', when:'Just now'}; else {kind:'checkin', body:'Checked in. '+(changed ? changed minus trailing '.'+'. ' : '')+(hasF ? 'Forecast holds at '+dm(fN)+'.' : ''), delta:'±0 BD', tone:'quiet'}. The new item is prepended and 'stale' feed items for that pid are removed. flash[pid] = !!slipBD (cleared after 1100ms). moved[pid] = slipBD ? {delta, label, at} : null (cleared after 5200ms).

BATCH UPDATE applyUpdate(changes): group changes by project_id. For each project p0: pre.target = date of the last target_move. hpd = first hours_per_day with value > 0. If hpd and p0 has a forecast: from = max(TODAY, start); bdLeft = bdDiff(from, forecast) + 1; hoursLeft = (rate || 1) × bdLeft; need = max(1, ceil(hoursLeft / hpd.value)); k = rate ? hpd.value/rate : 1; set rate=hpd.value, bd3×=k, bd8×=k, rateAfter×=k, forecast=iso(addBD(from, need−1)), prev=old forecast. If hpd but no forecast, only rate changes. adds = task_add changes with text; they are appended to now[0].tasks as {id:'u'+Date.now().toString(36)+i, t:text, h:+hours||1}; if now is empty, a block {m:'Added from an update', due: addBD(TODAY,9), tasks:[]} is created first. Setting pre.target deletes targetLabel. These go through updateProject. If hpd changed the forecast, flash for 1100ms. Then applyCheckIn is ALWAYS called for the project with: done = task_done ids; changed = note texts (trailing '.' stripped) joined '. '; scopeWhat = scope_add texts joined ', '; scopeH = Σ scope_add hours; blockers = blocker text or ''; confidence = value or null. Scope slip is therefore computed on top of the new rate and forecast; this relies on the runtime's synchronous setState. bau_done: if routine_id==='r-ret' and r-ret occurs today → setAllFunds(true); otherwise bauDone[routine_id+':'+TODAY] = TODAY (only if not already set).

PREVIEW SHIFT previewShift(pid, h) (exported, but no screen currently calls it): returns null if the project has no forecast. delta = h>0 ? ceil(h/(rate||1)) : 0. to = addBD(forecastN, delta). Recompute dayLoad for BDs in (forecastN, to] with the extended project; newOver = days that become over and were not over before → {n, s, total}. Returns {delta, from, to, fromS, toS, fromDM, toDM, deltaLabel ('+N BD' or '±0 BD'), vsTarget: bdDiff(targetN,to), newOver, missesDecRun: pid==='ret' && to ≥ DEC_RUN, crossesMove: domain==='pc' && to ≥ MOVE}. Seed ret +6h → +2 BD, Wed 2 Dec → Fri 4 Dec, new overload Fri 4 Dec 9h, missesDecRun true.

NEW PROJECT DEFAULTS createProject(domain): id 'p'+Date.now(); name and short 'Untitled project'; goal ''; start TODAY; target = forecast = addBD(TODAY,30) (Mon 16 Nov in the seed); prev null; exit [] for pc, null for fi; confidence null; checkin null; phase 0; rate, bd3, bd8, rateAfter, baseline all 0; endName 'Done'. Then go to the workspace with ws=id, focusGoal=id (Workspace focuses the goal textarea and calls clearFocusGoal), and close the palette.

COMMAND PALETTE SEARCH paletteGroups: q = trimmed lowercase query. Quick-add regex hm = q.match(/\+?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*h\b/). If it matches: h = parseFloat(group 1); rest = q with the match removed, trimmed. For each project with a forecast whose (name+' '+short).toLowerCase() contains rest (or all such projects if rest is empty), add {group:'Quick add', label:'Add '+h+'h of scope to '+short, hint:'check-in', dot:accent, run: openCheckIn(id,{scopeH:h})}. In quick-add mode NO other groups appear. Otherwise, in this order: 'Jump to' = SCREENS whose label contains q (all if q is empty), hint '', dot 'var(--hairline)'. 'Projects' = projects whose name contains q, hint forecastS, dot accent. 'Tell Remi' = projects where ('check in '+name) contains q (all if q is empty), label 'Tell Remi about '+short, hint sinceLabel. 'Create' = ['New Private Credit project' (dot pc-accent), 'New Fixed Income project' (dot fi-accent)], each shown if q is empty, or the label contains q, or 'new project'.includes(q). 'Reset to sample data' (hint 'clears your edits', dot 'var(--ink-faint)') only when q is non-empty and 'reset sample data'.includes(q). Truncate to 16 items overall. sel = min(pal.i, max(0, len−1)). Groups are built in order of first appearance. With an empty query: 7 Jump to + 5 Projects + 4 of 5 Tell Remi (the 5th and both Create items are cut off by the 16 cap).

PERSISTENCE DEBOUNCE: in componentDidUpdate, if any of projects, tasks, feed, funds, routines, doneOn, bauDone or notes changed by reference since the last snapshot (_sv), clear the pending timer and save 250ms later. Nothing saves until _sv exists, which is set on the first componentDidUpdate. The first data change after mount can be skipped if it is the first update.
HOME FADE: goHome sets the stage's inline style to opacity 0 over 180ms, then navigates.
backendImplications: ENTITIES: Project, with child collections: NowBlock (milestone name, due) → Task (id, text, hours, due?); NextItem (milestone, due); ScopeChange (date, what, hours, slipBD, fromDate, toDate); CheckIn (date, note, forecast, confidence, milestoneSnapshot?); Risk (risk, mitigation); Checklist → ChecklistItem (done); Charter (why, success[], inScope[], outScope[], constraints[]); ReadinessItem (FI); explicit Milestones (legacy); per-day HourOverride (project, date, hours). Store fromDate/toDate as dates, not 'D Mon' strings.

Other entities: Routine (kind/bd/wd/hours/stage/pid/domain/statusNote/detail/readiness); RotationSegment config (country, code, lengthBD, pass, order) with dates derived server-side; HolidayCalendar (date, name, region: UK or ZA is an open question); Settings (move date, capacity hours, key-run date or rule, today override for demos, rotation daily hours = 4); TaskCompletion (taskId, done, doneOn); BauCompletion (routineId, occurrenceDate, doneOn); FundRunProgress (routine r-ret, run date, fundId, done); Fund reference list (12); Note (date, time, text, id); FeedEvent / activity log (projectId?, kind, title, body, delta chip, tone, createdAt timestamp; the 'when' label is formatted client-side).

CORE / UTILS (pure, shared): business-day calendar (isBD, bdOfMonth, nextBD, addBD, bdDiff, formatters). Must be dynamic, not a fixed range; either reject or extend when a date is outside the range instead of clamping or crashing. ORD, ruleText and ruleShort helpers.

SERVICES: CalendarService (holidays, BD numbering); LoadService (dayLoad over a date range with the exact precedence ov → rateAfter → BD3 → BD8 → rate, BAU before or after the move, the rotation, capacity/free/over); ForecastService (status/delta, derivedMilestones, scope-slip = ceil(h/rate), hours-per-day reforecast, previewShift incl. newOver/missesKeyRun/crossesMove); VerdictService (move verdict, buffer, toRun; replace the hard-coded 'ret'/DEC_RUN with configurable key project + key run); AttentionService (risk, overload window TODAY..MOVE+10BD, stale ≥7 days, prompt/nextDue); CheckInService (applyCheckIn + applyUpdate as ONE database transaction per submission); RoutineService (occurrences, next 3); ProjectService (create with defaults, delete with cascade to feed items and guard against deleting the last project); NotesService; FeedService.

API ENDPOINTS (suggested): GET /dashboard or /model (derived bundle: P with derived fields, loads for range, verdict, attention, prompt, nextDue, routines with next, upcoming, rotation, holidays, settings); GET /calendar?from&to; GET /loads?from&to; GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /projects[/id] (plus nested now/next/tasks/risks/checklists/charter/overrides); POST /projects/{id}/checkins (legacy shape); POST /updates (batch Change[]: task_done, task_add, scope_add, blocker, confidence, target_move, hours_per_day, note, bau_done); POST /projects/{id}/preview-shift {hours}; PUT /tasks/{id}/completion; PUT /bau-completions/{routineId}/{date}; PUT /fund-runs/{date}/funds/{i} and PUT all; GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /notes (by day); GET/POST /feed; CRUD /routines (removing a routine logs a feed 'edit' item); POST /dev/reset-sample-data (development only).

VALIDATION (to mirror CheckIn and the shell): confidence integer 1–5; hours_per_day 0<v≤8; task and scope hours clamped 0.25–80 (task default 1); text lengths 120 (task/scope) and 160 (note/blocker); target_move must be a valid date inside the calendar and snapped to the next BD; domain ∈ {pc, fi}; routine kind ∈ {monthly, weekly, daily}, stage 0–3, bd ≥1 (warn if the month has fewer BDs), wd 1–5; project start ≤ target; ids generated server-side (not Date.now()).

The server computes dates in a fixed business timezone. Replace TODAY with the real date (plus an optional demo override). The header date, BD number and countdown must come from the calendar service. The prototype hard-codes '61'; decide whether the countdown excludes today (bdDiff−1 = 61) or includes it (bdDiff = 62).

Persisted client state today is localStorage 'remi.v1'. On first run of the backend, provide a one-off import of a remi.v1 blob (projects, tasks, feed, funds, routines, doneOn, bauDone, notes, m2) so existing edits carry over.

UI-only state that should stay on the client (not persisted): screen, ws, hover, drawer, palette, flash/moved timers, vtPhase, instant, focus and request tokens. Consider putting screen and ws in the URL route (/today, /projects/:id, …).
risksAndQuirks: Hard-coded 'today' and header: TODAY is fixed at 2026-10-05. Header text 'Mon 5 Oct', 'BD3' and '61' is static markup, not bound. The computed bdDiff(TODAY, MOVE) is 62, so '61' means business days strictly between today and the move day. Remi Home, Foundations and Transition also hard-code 61.

MOVE (2027-01-04) and DEC_RUN (2026-12-03) are hard-coded; DEC_RUN should come from the r-ret routine's last occurrence before the move. The verdict logic hard-codes project id 'ret'. Deleting the 'ret' project crashes buildModel (pmap.ret undefined), and if there are no PC projects Math.max gives −Infinity and bdDiff returns NaN.
removeProject sets ws to s.projects.find(p => p.id !== id).id. It throws if the last project is removed.

The calendar only covers 2026-08-31 to 2027-04-30. addBD silently clamps at the ends. F.* formatters and dayLoad crash (CAL.days[n] undefined) for dates outside the range, e.g. a new project target beyond April 2027 or alpha work late in the window.
The HOL list is incomplete for England & Wales. 2026-08-31 (Summer bank holiday) is inside the range but treated as a business day. The holiday region (UK vs South Africa) is an open question.

dayLoad hard-codes routine items' domain as 'pc' and ignores ALL routines on or after MOVE, so FI routines a user adds never count. The rotation load is a hard-coded 4h/day. The project bd3/bd8 override days are the fixed numbers 3 and 8, not linked to the routines' bd values.

Hours model inconsistency: loads use ov/rateAfter/bd3/bd8, but scope slip uses ceil(h/rate) and hours-per-day reforecasts assume a flat rate × BD count. The same project can look different on the timeline and in the forecast. rate 0 falls back to 1 in slip maths, but new projects are created with rate 0, so they show no load.
'since' and 'stale' use calendar days, not business days (weekends count toward the 7-day stale threshold).

applyCheckIn always overwrites project.blocker with d.blockers || null. Any update or check-in that doesn't restate the blocker clears it. applyUpdate calls applyCheckIn for every project mentioned, so even a lone target_move writes a check-in record and resets checkin=TODAY.
applyCheckIn marks d.done tasks true but does NOT write doneOn, unlike toggleTask. Tasks completed via check-in have no completion date.

The runtime's setState is synchronous (StreamableLogic.__setLogicState merges into logic.state immediately; see support.js lines 967–972). applyUpdate calls updateProject then reads this.state in applyCheckIn, and openCheckIn/openPalette read this.state right after. In production React/Redux these must become one reducer, action or server transaction, or the second write will clobber the first.

Feed 'when' is a display string ('Just now', 'Today', 'Sat 3 Oct') saved to storage, so 'Just now' persists forever after reload. There are no timestamps apart from the id suffix. The seed feed also has a static 'No check-in for 9 days' stale item and a 4 Nov overload item that don't recompute.
funds (12 booleans) holds today's returns-run progress. It is not keyed by date and never resets for the next BD3. bau_done for r-ret only ticks all funds if r-ret occurs TODAY.
bauDone key format is '<routineId>:<ISO occurrence date>'; the value is the ISO done date. In Today, the r-ret occurrence on TODAY uses funds.every(Boolean) instead of bauDone.
addNote stamps the time from the real clock (new Date()), while the note date comes from the prototype's fixed TODAY. IDs are 'n'+Date.now().toString(36).
IDs come from Date.now() ('p…', 'r…' base36, 'u…' base36+i, 'f…', 'n…'), so there is a risk of collisions. Use server UUIDs.

Migration: the only versioning is the key name 'remi.v1' plus the flag m2. If a saved blob lacks m2, MAN0 {id:'man-0', t:'Send the NAV bridge spec to Finance', h:0.5, due:'2026-10-02'} is unshifted into manco.now[0].tasks. It is also always unshifted into BASE_PROJECTS[1] at module load. loadSaved only needs s.projects to be an array; the other keys fall back to seeds one by one.

Persistence starts only after the first componentDidUpdate sets _sv, so the very first state change after mount is never compared. Saves are debounced 250ms and errors are swallowed. Nothing is written until a data slice changes by reference.

resetData removes the storage key and restores seeds, but leaves drawer, flash, moved and focus state alone. In the palette it matches any substring of 'reset sample data', so typing 'e' or 'a' shows the destructive option.

Palette quirks: the 'Tell Remi' group matches against 'check in '+name, so typing 'tell' finds nothing there. The 16-item cap hides the Create items and the 5th Tell Remi item when the query is empty. The quick-add regex takes the first '<n>h' anywhere in the query. Quick add only offers projects that have a forecast.

reduced-motion is inconsistent: model.reduced only checks props.motion, while this.reduced() also checks prefers-reduced-motion. The view-transition 0s override only applies under data-motion='reduced', not the media query.

Accent tokens: the :root oklch values (--pc-accent oklch(0.5 0.1 128), --fi-accent oklch(0.5 0.1 265)) are always overridden by the accents prop, whose default is ['#526e2a','#47619c']. The effective accents in the prototype are those hex values. Brand colours are placeholders until the Ninety One template arrives.

The Material Symbols font is loaded with wght 300 only (axes opsz 20..24, wght 300, FILL 0..1, GRAD 0) and a fixed icon subset. The 'Tell Remi' icon asks for wght 400, which isn't loaded, so it renders at 300.
buildModel runs on every render, including hover changes and each palette keystroke. It recomputes 170 dayLoads × projects each time; memoise it in production or move it to the server.
previewShift is exported but not used by any screen; CheckIn does its own preview. The legacy applyCheckIn payload path (no .changes) is unreachable from the current CheckIn but still handled.

All 8 screens stay mounted and are only hidden. Production should either keep screens alive (to preserve scroll position and local state) or restore state on route change; unmounting will change behaviour.
openProject with viaCard only animates from the Projects screen, and only if document.startViewTransition exists (Chromium/Safari 18+).

goHome and other screens navigate between separate HTML files (Remi Home.dc.html, Remi Textbook.dc.html). Production needs a router. Remi Home also reads remi.v1 directly (count of notes for 2026-10-05, projects, routines).
Nav 'Projects' has no separate Workspace entry; the Workspace screen is only reachable via openProject or createProject.
actionsInvoked: updateProject(id, fn): projects = map, replacing the matching project with normalize(fn(p)).

logChange(item): feed = [{id:'f'+Date.now(), when:'Just now', tone:'quiet', ...item}, ...feed]. Callers: Routines ({pid:null, kind:'edit', title, body:'Handover status X → Y.' (+' It drops off your plan.' at stage 3), delta:'BAU'}) and Workspace ({pid, kind:'edit', title:short, body:'Target moved A → B.', delta:'Target'}).
createProject(domain): appends a normalized default project, screen='workspace', ws=id, instant=false, closes the palette, focusGoal=id.
removeProject(id): removes the project and every feed item with that pid; screen='projects'; ws = first other project id.
updateRoutine(id, fn): routines = map with normR(fn(x)).
addRoutine(): appends normR({id:'r'+Date.now().toString(36), name:'', short:''}); focusRoutine=id.
removeRoutine(id): removes it; if it had a name, logChange({pid:null, kind:'edit', title:name, body:'Routine removed from the plan.', delta:'BAU'}).

resetData(): localStorage.removeItem('remi.v1'); restores notes, doneOn, bauDone={}, routines, projects, feed, funds (first 5 true), tasks {'ret-1':true,'fi-1':true}, ws='ret', screen='today', closes the palette.
go(screen): screen, instant=false, closes the palette.
setHover(id): hover = id || null (only if changed).
openProject(id, viaCard): closes the palette; screen='workspace', ws=id, with an optional view transition (vtPhase, vtId, instant).
openCheckIn(pid, prefill): drawer={open:true, pid, session+1, prefill}; closes the palette.
closeDrawer(): drawer.open=false.
openPalette(): pal={open:true, q:'', i:0}; focuses the input after 30ms. closePalette(): pal.open=false.
toggleFund(i): funds[i] = !funds[i]. setAllFunds(v): funds = 12 × v.
toggleTask(id): tasks[id] = !tasks[id]; doneOn[id] = TODAY ISO when on, deleted when off.
toggleBau(key): bauDone[key] = TODAY ISO, or deleted if already set.
addNote(day ISO, text): appends {id:'n'+base36(now), t:'HH:MM' local clock, text} to notes[day]; returns id.
updateNote(day, id, text): replaces the text. removeNote(day, id): filters it out; deletes the day key if the list is now empty.
saveCheckIn(d): closeDrawer, then after 220ms applyUpdate(d.changes) or applyCheckIn(d).
applyCheckIn(d): changes the project's forecast, prev, confidence, checkin, blocker, scope[] and checkins[]; tasks; feed (prepend and drop that project's stale items); flash (1100ms); moved (5200ms).

applyUpdate(changes): per project, target/rate/bd3/bd8/rateAfter/forecast/prev and now[0].tasks via updateProject; flash; then applyCheckIn. For bau_done: setAllFunds(true) for r-ret today, or a bauDone key.
openRoutine(id): routineReq={id, t}, screen='routines', instant=false.
previewDay(n): dayReq={n, t}, screen='today', instant=false.
clearFocusGoal(): focusGoal=null. clearFocusRoutine(): focusRoutine=null.

applyTweaks() (on mount and every update): injects <style id='remi-ph'> once (placeholder colour color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink-faint) 70%, var(--paper)), opacity 1; date-picker indicator opacity 0.45, cursor pointer); sets documentElement.dataset.motion to 'reduced' or 'full'; sets or removes --pc-accent and --fi-accent from the accents prop; if serif === false, sets --font-display to var(--font-ui).
localState: routines: Routine[] (normR). Drives BAU load, Routines screen, Today BAU list.
funds: bool[12]. Seed first 5 true (5 of 12 funds done today).
screen: the active screen id (default 'today'). ws: the workspace project id (default 'ret').
hover: shared hover id for cross-highlighting.
vw / vh: window size for frame scaling.
focusGoal / focusRoutine: one-shot focus requests consumed by Workspace / Routines.
routineReq {id,t} / dayReq {n,t}: request tokens telling Routines / Today to open a routine or day.

Instance fields: palRef (input ref); _palFlat / _palSel (cached palette items and selection for key handling); _sv (last persisted snapshot); saveT (debounce timer); fT / mT (per-project flash and moved timers); onResize / onKey (listeners).
persistence: localStorage key 'remi.v1'. Saved shape: {projects: Project[] (stored, not derived), tasks: {id: bool}, feed: FeedEvent[], funds: bool[12], routines: Routine[], doneOn: {id: ISO}, bauDone: {'rid:ISO': ISO}, notes: {ISO: [{id, t, text}]}, m2: true}.

Load (module evaluation, once): JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('remi.v1') || 'null'). Accepted only if the result is an object with an array `projects`, else null. Parse errors give null. Each state slice falls back to its seed if missing (routines → ROUTINES; feed → BASE_FEED; funds → first 5 true; tasks → {'ret-1':true,'fi-1':true}; notes → BASE_NOTES; doneOn → BASE_DONE_ON; bauDone → {}). Projects and routines are normalized on load.

Migration m2: if the saved blob has no m2 flag, the task MAN0 {id:'man-0', t:'Send the NAV bridge spec to Finance', h:0.5, due:'2026-10-02'} is inserted at the start of manco.now[0].tasks (if missing), then SAVED.m2 = true. m2:true is written on every save.

Save: in componentDidUpdate, when any of the 8 slices changes by reference, save with a 250ms debounce (clearTimeout plus setTimeout). JSON.stringify of the slices. Exceptions (quota, private mode) are swallowed.
Reset: 'Reset to sample data' in the palette calls localStorage.removeItem('remi.v1') and restores seeds in memory. A later change re-saves.
Not persisted: screen, ws, hover, drawer, pal, flash, moved, vt*, focus*, *Req, vw/vh. Reload always opens Today with ws 'ret'.
Other files: Remi Home.dc.html reads 'remi.v1' for counts. Remi Textbook uses its own key 'remi.textbook.v1'.
externalCalls: ./support.js (dc runtime; loads React 18.3.1 UMD, ReactDOM 18.3.1 and Babel standalone 7.29.0 from unpkg; renders with createRoot).
document.startViewTransition (View Transitions API) for the project card → workspace morph.

No AI calls in the shell. The child CheckIn calls window.claude.complete({system, max_tokens:1800, messages:[{role:'user', content:'CONTEXT
'+JSON(context)+'

UPDATE
'+text}]}) and returns {changes} to the shell's saveCheckIn.
